'''Heeds''' are a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Crude Parasites|Crude]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns in groups of 1 to 2, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]] onward, with a spawnweight of 5.
* Spawned by a [[Stage II Dispatcher]] collecting [[Incomplete Forms]].
* Spawned by level 2 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Heeds are Melee/Offensive Support Combatants.

*Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*The Heed is capable of spawning [[Scent System|Scents]] upon sight of a target, with a cooldown of 50 seconds.
*Heeds are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Heeds are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Heeds, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* The abdomen on Heed functions as a Weak Point. When this Weak Point is hit, damage inflicted to it is tripled and the [[Bleeding]] Effect is applied to it.
